text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. The breeze feels
fresh
this morning, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I did. I hiked a mountain yesterday and
spent my
day listening to all the voices
of nature.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got some proper rest.
Looks like you were able to get so...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I heard the leaves rustling and the birds
singing,
and smelled the scent of the
earth as the wind
carried it along.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt as if I could have stayed there on
the side of
that mountain forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the notion of her staying in the
wilderness "forever" is somewhat
troubling, I'm glad to hear
that Yamanin
Zephyr had a relaxing day off.
